title: Fermented Depth
summary: Miso, kimchi, fish sauce, sourdough — fermentation adds complexity you cannot fake quickly.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — fermented depth is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: ferment, umami, acid. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Use kimchi juice in fried rice
Fresh raw veg and acid keep fermented dishes from feeling one-dimensional.
